name: Nidhogg

skills.name: Dragon's True Form
skills.description: Passive: Nidhogg's dragon bloodline makes him immune to possession by any unit. Active: Transforms into "Dark Dragon Form", increasing ATK and Max HP by 100%, and dealing DMG equal to 400% of ATK to all enemies. The dragon's might silences them for 5s. After transforming, clears all buffs and debuffs. For each buff cleared, increases ATK and Max HP by 40%, up to 3 stacks. During "Dark Dragon Form", increases ATK SPD by 150%, and converts 40% of DMG dealt into True DMG. Normal Attacks deal DMG equal to 150% of ATK to enemies in a fan-shaped area in front, and inflict [Dragon's Wrath] on hit enemies (Dragon's Wrath: DMG taken from Dark Dragon Form increases by 3%, up to 10 stacks) while continuously draining Energy. Exits "Dark Dragon Form" when Energy is depleted.

upgrades.level2: Deals DMG equal to 500% of ATK to all enemies.
upgrades.level3: Deals DMG equal to 600% of ATK to all enemies.
upgrades.level4: Dragon's Wrath: Increases DMG taken from Nidhogg by 5%, up to 10 stacks.

skills.name: Worldroot Blightfire
skills.description: Deals DMG equal to 200% of ATK to the nearest enemy and enemies within a 3m AoE, and reduces Armor and M-RES by 20% for 12s. Dark Dragon Form: Unleashes dragon breath at enemies in front, dealing DMG equal to 250% of ATK and burning them, reducing Armor and M-RES by 30%, and dealing DMG equal to 50% of ATK per sec for 8s.

upgrades.level2: Armor and M-RES reduction increases to 25%. Dark Dragon Form Armor and M-RES reduction increases to 35%.
upgrades.level3: Increases DMG to 250% of ATK. Dark Dragon Form DMG increases to 300% of ATK.
upgrades.level4: Increases Dark Dragon Form burn DMG per sec to 80%.

skills.name: Doomwyrm's Dread
skills.description: Passive: In Dark Dragon Form, when any unit comes within 3m of Nidhogg, deals DMG equal to 250% ATK to enemies within a 5m AoE and inflicts Terror on them for 2.5s. Enemies inflicted with Terror gain an extra 3 stacks of [Dragon's Wrath]. This effect triggers once every 18s.

upgrades.level2: This effect triggers once every 16s. Terror duration is increased to 3s.
upgrades.level3: Enemies inflicted with Terror take 15% increased DMG for 5s.

skills.name: Abyssal Wyrm Surge
skills.description: Deals DMG equal to 200% ATK to the nearest enemy and knocks them down. Dark Dragon Form: Summons hellfire to deal DMG equal to 250% ATK to the nearest enemy and enemies within a 3m AoE, knocking them down.

upgrades.level2: Increases DMG dealt to 225% ATK. DMG is increased to 275% ATK in Dark Dragon Form.
upgrades.level3: Enemies hit in Dark Dragon Form take 15% more DMG for 6s.
upgrades.level4: Increases DMG dealt to 250% ATK. DMG is increased to 300% ATK in Dark Dragon Form.

relic.name: Deathless Wrathscale
relic.description: Gains a shield equal to 80% of Max HP each time an Ultimate is cast. DMG taken is reduced by 40% while the shield is active.

upgrades.level2: Immune to Control effects while the Shield generated by the Ultimate is active.
upgrades.level3: For every 3 stacks of Dragon's Wrath applied to an enemy, stuns the target for an extra 2s. If the target is Immune to Control effects, deals extra True DMG equal to 200% ATK instead.
upgrades.level4: 60% of the DMG dealt in Dark Dragon Form is converted to True DMG.

coreMechanic.summary: Nidhogg builds Energy as a human, then transforms into a separate Dark Dragon unit. The form drains Energy and ends when Energy runs out or the dragon dies, at which point the human returns. Dragon uptime is his real resource: it decides how much of Dragon's Wrath, burn, armor shred and True DMG he ever applies.

description: A transformation-based physical Archer. Human form is the preparation phase; once Energy is full he turns into the Dark Dragon, a fast AoE carry with armor shred, burn, Dragon's Wrath amplification and a large share of True DMG. His output depends almost entirely on reaching Dark Dragon Form and keeping it alive.
strengths: Huge damage ceiling in Dark Dragon Form - +150% ATK SPD, 150% ATK fan-shaped basic attacks and burn up to 80% ATK per sec at Lv4; in suitable fights he can account for 87-97% of team damage
Self-sufficient armor shred - Worldroot Blightfire reduces Armor and M-RES by up to 35%, so he needs far less external shred than a typical physical carry

Stacking damage amplification - Dragon's Wrath adds up to +50% DMG taken from Nidhogg at Lv4, plus separate +15% DMG windows from Doomwyrm's Dread and Abyssal Wyrm Surge (additive vs multiplicative stacking is unconfirmed)
High True DMG share - 40% of DMG dealt in dragon form is True DMG, 60% with Relic Lv4, which makes enemy Armor largely irrelevant
Transformation control - 5s mass Silence on transform, plus Knockdown, Terror and Relic Lv3 stuns (or 200% ATK True DMG against control-immune targets)
Relic protection - Shield equal to 80% Max HP and 40% DMG reduction on every Ultimate, with Control immunity from Relic Lv2
weaknesses: Unreliable transformation - Dark Dragon Form arrives roughly 13-16s into a fight; fights under about 12s sometimes ended without a transform at all
Dragon uptime varies wildly - the dragon lived about 11-12s in Tower 721, about 44s in World Boss and until the end of some Odyssey / Alliance Boss fights
Vulnerability window after dragon death - in every Tower 721 loss the human Nidhogg died 1.1-5.6s after his last dragon fell
Weak in short fights and against heavy early burst, since the payoff only starts after the transform
Poor investment efficiency - a widely read TapTap guide (updated 12 Aug 2026) rates him lower-mid tier with few use cases and suggests skipping him on tight resources
No confirmed PvP data and no confirmed team synergies yet - Energy support and dragon healing/shielding still need testing
f2pInvestment: Low priority on tight resources. Skill levels work on their own, but the kit only feels complete at Relic Lv3 and peaks at Relic Lv4. Divine rank effects are not documented yet.
